title: ProcedureHierarchicalCharacterExtraction
description: Schema for extracting a procedure, its baseline code state, and an array of nested next-character options complete with their textual justifications.

norm_procedure.description: The normalized, standard name of the medical or operational procedure.

current_code.description: The current alphanumeric prefix code or baseline state being evaluated.

next_character_data.description: A list of data objects containing potential next character values, definitions, and supporting evidence.

next_character_value.description: The specific value or token representing the next character slot in the sequence.

next_character_desc.description: The description, definition, or clinical meaning of the next character value.

next_character_evidences.description: The specific source text fragments used to justify this particular next character value.

text.description: The exact phrase or text excerpt serving as direct documentation evidence.

pg_no.description: The absolute page number where this exact evidence is found in the source document.

reftxtbefore.description: The contextual text directly preceding the evidence snippet.

reftxtafter.description: The contextual text directly following the evidence snippet.
